title: Evidence-gated lesson contract for mission distillation
summary: Mission distillation now emits an optional experience record {cue,lesson,evidence,confidence} plus per-change attribution rows with a confounded verdict; the promotion queue carries and flags them so weak lessons are narrowed or declined instead of promoted.
hint_triggers: Adopted harness2's experience contract: a lesson is promotable only when it names (a) the shape of situation it applies to (cue, not task facts), (b) the operation on a named component (lesson), (c) the edit rows it rests on (evidence), and (d) a confidence level. Per-change rows take verdicts helped|hurt|no_observed_effect|confounded — prefer confounded over invented attribution when several components changed at once. A lesson resting only on confounded rows is a guess: narrow it or omit experience entirely (NO_ENTRY is valid). Facts verified in a workspace are task-scoped anchors and do not promote; transferable procedure does. When no complete experience is emitted, the candidate is flagged distill_experience_declined and the review warns; low-confidence lessons warn to narrow or decline; brokered cross-tier promotions warn that free-text lesson fields may carry tenant detail.
